newsitem.title: INDIA: India clears VSNL GDR issue.
newsitem.headline: India clears VSNL GDR issue.

text.p: The Indian government on Thursday permitted state-run Videsh Sanchar Nigam Ltd (VSNL) to relaunch its issue of global depositary receipts (GDRs), the Press Trust of India (PTI) reported.
"The union cabinet has given its clearance to VSNL to relaunch its ambitious global depositary issue," PTI said.
The agency quoted official sources as saying details like the size and pricing of the issue would be decided by a panel of bureaucrats earlier set up by the government.

Market sources estimate the issue size will be somewhere between $650 million and $800 million. It will be the state-run telecom firm's third launch attempt in two years after two unsuccessful attempts in 1994.
Investment banks Kleinwort Benson, Salomon Brothers and Jardine Fleming are global coordinators to the issue.
